record.name: Burundi
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. A National AI Strategy 2025-2030 was validated in April 2026 and provides for a national AI commission and a strategic intelligence centre; no evaluation or testing function is described.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. No retained English query. The retrieved material does not sufficiently establish the national AI governance arrangements. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. No qualifying institute was identified. The foreign ministry primary page concerns an East African Community regional AI strategy consultation, not the establishment of a Burundian national evaluation body. The national-strategy validation lead at ABP could not be retrieved, including via a text copy service. National governance evidence remains limited. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

Re-ran searches in English, French and Kirundi for a government-designated institute that evaluates advanced models, or a commitment, proposal or study naming one. No qualifying institute or commitment was identified; results described the national AI strategy validated in April 2026 with a planned national AI commission and strategic intelligence centre, and the November 2025 AI landscape assessment. Retrieved the ministry's account of the AI landscape assessment as new primary governance evidence. The Kirundi query could not be validated and nothing rests on it. Raised confidence to medium under the status-confidence rule: recorded queries in English and a national or official language, and cited primary governance evidence consistent with no qualifying institute. Partial check; the last full-check date is unchanged.

check.language_note: The recorded fr query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged. The Prime Minister's country profile lists English under official languages, so English searches also count towards that language requirement. On 24 October 2026 the record was searched again in English, French and Kirundi; the result links of each query were matched against registered sources in the same way.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: The Lawyers Hub desk-research profile was read, but independence of its underlying citations from the paired national or press source was not verified. It is not counted as a second evidence origin. Confidence was low under that rule; none_identified is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.
check.governance_note: The finance and digital economy ministry's November 2025 account of a workshop to make a complete diagnosis of Burundi's AI ecosystem says its conclusions will feed the strategic roadmap for AI development, and that AI must be understood, anticipated and regulated. It names no body to evaluate advanced models.

related_bodies.name: Ministry of Finance, Budget and Digital Economy
related_bodies.role: It leads the AI strategy with UNDP support; it owns the policy.

related_bodies.name: Commission Nationale de l'Intelligence Artificielle (planned)
related_bodies.role: It is a governance body provided for in the validated strategy; no evaluation mandate was reported. This was reported by Digital Business Africa.

record.notes: Cited foreign sources for the governance context: Digital Business Africa; Lawyers Hub, Africa AI Policy Lab. Evidence is press reporting plus a secondary profile; the strategy text was not found. A UNDP page on the November 2025 workshop was also read through a proxy but is not cited. Searched in French and English.

next_check.reason: Check whether the strategy is adopted and what mandate the planned commission gets.
